speaker: Doctor
text: The development of a rash after amoxicillin and its resolution after switching to cephalexin suggests a penicillin allergy, which is a crucial risk factor for developing a drug-resistant infection. Given your history of sinusitis and current flank pain with fever, have you experienced any urinary symptoms like urgency, frequency, or a burning sensation during urination? text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN). The presence of binucleated eosinophilic cells in the urine (eosinophiluria), combined with a history of recent antibiotic use (amoxicillin/cephalexin) and fever, strongly supports this allergic reaction of the kidney.
